certificate.description: The Sansec HSM Cryptographic Module is a multi-chip standalone hardware cryptographic module that provides core functions such as device management, key management, and cryptographic services. The module delivers key storage and cryptographic services to external applications through virtual security modules (VSMs), including data encryption, data decryption, signature generation, signature verification, message digest, message authentication code (MAC), and random number generation.
